largest_vegas_favorite.note: Largest raw Vegas favorite this week (-750 ML, -11.5 vs TEN, ~85% no-vig implied). Never the recommendation by policy. The Arbiter put it at 0.83, the top number on the board, so the pick goes to the next-best non-excluded team: MIN (0.80).

status_note: Strategy run as ELIMINATED (Week 2 loss). No opportunity-cost logic; recommendation = highest Arbiter probability among non-excluded teams. Used: DET, TB, SF.
process_note: 10-team shortlist (BAL, MIN, SEA, BUF, KC, IND, LA, CHI, GB, HOU) went through Advocate -> independent Skeptic subagent -> independent Arbiter subagent, with lessons L1-L9 threaded into all three. L1 drove KC's trap flag (reverse line movement plus a rookie LT). L5/L8 drove GB's (weak own form, gutted interior). L7 discounted IND and CHI on opponent-QB / own-QB pricing. L8 kept SEA's missing RBs from being called a wash. All 32 teams are on the board (L3).

board.summary: The Advocate's core holds: TEN is 0-3 at -7.3 pd/g, and Lamar is cleared. But Hendrickson being OUT undercuts the pressure-vs-TEN's-IR-guards angle. The line move came on public money, not reverse movement, and rain favors BAL's better defense, so it's no trap. Shaved two points per L2. Excluded from the recommendation as the week's largest Vegas favorite.

board.summary: L4 is satisfied: MIA's collapse is concrete and current (-16.7 pd/g, every loss by double digits, Achane out for the season), and sharp money pushed the line from -7.5 to -10.5. The Skeptic's points are real: MIN's offense ranks last and Jefferson is out, and a 38.5 total leaves room for a turnover-decided game. That trims MIN below market, but the matchup gap is the biggest on the board outside BAL.
